name: io.github.Komplyzen/komplyt-zero
title: Komplyt Zero
description: Self-hosted knowledge-graph memory for AI agents on SurrealDB: semantic search and decay.

environmentVariables.name: KG_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted use: one fixed local user, no login.

environmentVariables.name: KG_DB_URL
environmentVariables.description: SurrealDB WebSocket URL, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:8000. See docs/self-hosting.md for a compose file that starts SurrealDB.

environmentVariables.name: KG_JWT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Server secret for the kg_server SurrealDB signin, at least 32 characters.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: cohere or ollama. One per install.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434 (required for ollama).

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key when the provider needs one (cohere).
